Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott.

Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition applyfs (fs : ls) (A : styp) :=
  fold_right (fun el acc =>
                match el with
                | st_ty A => styp_arrow A acc
                | st_la l => styp_rcd l acc
                end) A fs.

Theorem ASub2sub : forall fs A B c,
    ASub fs A B c -> sub A (applyfs fs B) c.

Theorem sub2ASub : forall A B c,
    sub A B c -> exists c', ASub nil A B c'.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition i := nat.

Inductive co : Set :=
 | co_id : co
 | co_trans (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_top : co
 | co_arr (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_pair (c1:co) (c2:co)
 | co_proj1 : co
 | co_proj2 : co
 | co_distArr : co
 | co_distRcd (l:i)
 | co_rcd (l:i) (c:co)
 | co_topArr : co
 | co_topRcd (l:i).

Inductive styp : Set :=
 | styp_top : styp
 | styp_nat : styp
 | styp_and (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_arrow (A:styp) (B:styp)
 | styp_rcd (l:i) (A:styp)  .

Inductive st : Set :=
 | st_ty (A:styp)
 | st_la (l:i).

Definition ls : Set := list st.

Fixpoint calAnd (fs : ls) : co :=
  match fs with
  | nil => co_id
  | cons l fs' =>
    match l with
    | st_ty _ => (co_trans (co_arr co_id (calAnd fs')) co_distArr)
    | st_la l => (co_trans (co_rcd l (calAnd fs')) (co_distRcd l))
    end
  end.

Fixpoint calTop (fs : ls) : co :=
  match fs with
  | nil => co_top
  | cons l fs' =>
    match l with
    | st_ty _ =>  (co_trans (co_arr co_id (calTop fs')) (co_trans (co_arr co_top co_top) (co_trans co_topArr co_top)))
    | st_la l => (co_trans (co_rcd l (calTop fs')) (co_topRcd l))
    end
  end.

Inductive sub : styp -> styp -> co -> Prop :=
 | S_refl : forall (A:styp),
     sub A A co_id
 | S_trans : forall (A1 A3:styp) (c1 c2:co) (A2:styp),
     sub A2 A3 c1 ->
     sub A1 A2 c2 ->
     sub A1 A3 (co_trans c1 c2)
 | S_top : forall (A:styp),
     sub A styp_top co_top
 | S_topArr :
     sub styp_top (styp_arrow styp_top styp_top) co_topArr
 | S_topRcd : forall (l:i),
     sub styp_top (styp_rcd l styp_top) (co_topRcd l)
 | S_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     sub B1 A1 c1 ->
     sub A2 B2 c2 ->
     sub (styp_arrow A1 A2) (styp_arrow B1 B2) (co_arr c1 c2)
 | S_and : forall (A1 A2 A3:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     sub A1 A2 c1 ->
     sub A1 A3 c2 ->
     sub A1 (styp_and A2 A3) (co_pair c1 c2)
 | S_andl : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     sub (styp_and A1 A2) A1 co_proj1
 | S_andr : forall (A1 A2:styp),
     sub (styp_and A1 A2) A2 co_proj2
 | S_distArr : forall (A1 A2 A3:styp),
     sub (styp_and  (styp_arrow A1 A2)   (styp_arrow A1 A3) ) (styp_arrow A1 (styp_and A2 A3)) co_distArr
 | S_rcd : forall (l:i) (A B:styp) (c:co),
     sub A B c ->
     sub (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B) (co_rcd l c)
 | S_distRcd : forall (l:i) (A B:styp),
     sub (styp_and (styp_rcd l A) (styp_rcd l B)) (styp_rcd l (styp_and A B)) (co_distRcd l).

Inductive ASub : ls -> styp -> styp -> co -> Prop :=
 | A_nat :
     ASub  nil  styp_nat styp_nat co_id
 | A_rcdNat : forall (l:i) (fs:ls) (A:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A styp_nat c ->
     ASub  (cons (st_la  l )  fs )  (styp_rcd l A) styp_nat (co_rcd l c)
 | A_rcd : forall (fs:ls) (A:styp) (l:i) (B:styp) (c:co),
     ASub  ( fs  ++ (cons (st_la  l ) nil))  A B c ->
     ASub fs A (styp_rcd l B) c
 | A_top : forall (fs:ls) (A:styp),
     ASub fs A styp_top (co_trans  (calTop  fs )  co_top)
 | A_and : forall (fs:ls) (A B1 B2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     ASub fs A B1 c1 ->
     ASub fs A B2 c2 ->
     ASub fs A (styp_and B1 B2) (co_trans  (calAnd  fs )  (co_pair c1 c2))
 | A_arr : forall (fs:ls) (A B1 B2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub  ( fs  ++ (cons (st_ty  B1 ) nil))  A B2 c ->
     ASub fs A (styp_arrow B1 B2) c
 | A_andN1 : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A1 styp_nat c ->
     ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) styp_nat (co_trans c co_proj1)
 | A_andN2 : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c:co),
     ASub fs A2 styp_nat c ->
     ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) styp_nat (co_trans c co_proj2)
 | A_arrNat : forall (A:styp) (fs:ls) (A1 A2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
     ASub  nil  A A1 c1 ->
     ASub fs A2 styp_nat c2 ->
     ASub  (cons (st_ty  A )  fs )  (styp_arrow A1 A2) styp_nat (co_arr c1 c2).

# 165 — NeColus subtyping algorithm correctness

## Task

Prove soundness and completeness of the list-based subtyping algorithm relative to declarative subtyping, with the supplied coercion judgments.

Prove all of the following declarations in `Task.v`:

- `ASub2sub`
- `sub2ASub`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.
Metalib

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import syntax_ott.
Require Import List.
Import ListNotations.

Lemma applyfs_app : forall (fs1 fs2:ls) (B:styp),
    applyfs (fs1 ++ fs2) B = applyfs fs1 (applyfs fs2 B).
Proof.
  intros fs1. induction fs1 as [|x xs IH]; intros fs2 B.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct x as [A|l]; simpl; [rewrite IH | rewrite IH]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma applyfs_snoc_ty : forall (fs:ls) (A B:styp),
    applyfs (fs ++ [st_ty A]) B = applyfs fs (styp_arrow A B).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite applyfs_app. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma applyfs_snoc_la : forall (fs:ls) (l:i) (B:styp),
    applyfs (fs ++ [st_la l]) B = applyfs fs (styp_rcd l B).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite applyfs_app. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma app_assoc' : forall (a b c:list st), (a ++ b) ++ c = a ++ (b ++ c).
Proof. intros. rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity. Qed.

(* and_left *)
Lemma ASub_and_l : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2 B:styp) (c:co),
    ASub fs A1 B c -> exists c', ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) B c'.
Proof.
  intros fs A1 A2 B c H. induction H.
  - (* A_nat *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_nat.
  - (* A_rcdNat *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - (* A_rcd *) eexists. apply A_rcd. apply IHH.
  - (* A_top *) eexists. apply A_top.
  - (* A_and *) eexists. apply A_and; assumption.
  - (* A_arr *) eexists. apply A_arr. apply IHH.
  - (* A_andN1 *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_andN1. assumption.
  - (* A_andN2 *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_andN2. assumption.
  - (* A_arrNat *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ASub_and_r : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2 B:styp) (c:co),
    ASub fs A2 B c -> exists c', ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) B c'.
Proof.
  intros fs A1 A2 B c H. induction H.
  - (* A_nat *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_nat.
  - (* A_rcdNat *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - (* A_rcd *) eexists. apply A_rcd. apply IHH.
  - (* A_top *) eexists. apply A_top.
  - (* A_and *) eexists. apply A_and; assumption.
  - (* A_arr *) eexists. apply A_arr. apply IHH.
  - (* A_andN1 *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_andN1. assumption.
  - (* A_andN2 *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_andN2. assumption.
  - (* A_arrNat *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
Qed.

(* lift arrow on top of a derivation *)
Lemma ASub_arr_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (B1 A1 A2:styp),
    ASub nil B1 A1 ->
    ASub fs A2 B ->
    exists c, ASub (st_ty B1 :: fs) (styp_arrow A1 A2) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l B' IHB]; intros fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H2.
  - (* top *) eexists. apply A_top.
  - (* nat *) eexists. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
  - (* and *) inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c1 Hc1].
    destruct (IHB2 fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H4) as [c2 Hc2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - (* arrow *) inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
  - (* rcd *) inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l]) B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
Qed.

Lemma ASub_rcd_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (l:i) (A:styp),
    ASub fs A B ->
    exists c, ASub (st_la l :: fs) (styp_rcd l A) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l' B' IHB]; intros fs l A H2.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs l A H3) as [c1 Hc1].
    destruct (IHB2 fs l A H4) as [c2 Hc2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) l A H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l']) l A H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
Qed.

(* reflexivity *)
Lemma ASub_refl : forall (A:styp), exists c, ASub nil A A c.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2|l A IHA].
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_nat.
  - destruct IHA1 as [c1 H1]. destruct IHA2 as [c2 H2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - destruct IHA1 as [c1 H1]. destruct IHA2 as [c2 H2].
    destruct (ASub_arr_lift A2 nil A1 A1 A2 H1 H2) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. apply Hc.
  - destruct IHA as [c H]. destruct (ASub_rcd_lift A nil l A H) as [c' Hc'].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. apply Hc'.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott.

Require Import List.

Import ListNotations.

Definition applyfs (fs : ls) (A : styp) :=
  fold_right (fun el acc =>
                match el with
                | st_ty A => styp_arrow A acc
                | st_la l => styp_rcd l acc
                end) A fs.

Lemma applyfs_app : forall (fs1 fs2:ls) (B:styp),
    applyfs (fs1 ++ fs2) B = applyfs fs1 (applyfs fs2 B).
Proof.
  intros fs1. induction fs1 as [|x xs IH]; intros fs2 B.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct x as [A|l]; simpl; [rewrite IH | rewrite IH]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma applyfs_snoc_ty : forall (fs:ls) (A B:styp),
    applyfs (fs ++ [st_ty A]) B = applyfs fs (styp_arrow A B).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite applyfs_app. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma applyfs_snoc_la : forall (fs:ls) (l:i) (B:styp),
    applyfs (fs ++ [st_la l]) B = applyfs fs (styp_rcd l B).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite applyfs_app. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* and_left / and_right: the source may be projected *)
Lemma ASub_and_l : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2 B:styp) (c:co),
    ASub fs A1 B c -> exists c', ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) B c'.
Proof.
  intros fs A1 A2 B c H. induction H.
  - eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_nat.
  - eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_rcd. apply IHH.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_and; assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_arr. apply IHH.
  - eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_andN1. assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_andN2. assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ASub_and_r : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2 B:styp) (c:co),
    ASub fs A2 B c -> exists c', ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) B c'.
Proof.
  intros fs A1 A2 B c H. induction H.
  - eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_nat.
  - eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_rcd. apply IHH.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_and; assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_arr. apply IHH.
  - eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_andN1. assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_andN2. assumption.
  - eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
Qed.

(* lifting a derivation under an arrow constructor *)
Lemma ASub_arr_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (B1 A1 A2:styp),
    ASub nil B1 A1 ->
    ASub fs A2 B ->
    exists c, ASub (st_ty B1 :: fs) (styp_arrow A1 A2) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l B' IHB]; intros fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H2.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c1 Hc1].
    destruct (IHB2 fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H4) as [c2 Hc2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l]) B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
Qed.

(* lifting a derivation under a record constructor *)
Lemma ASub_rcd_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (l:i) (A:styp),
    ASub fs A B ->
    exists c, ASub (st_la l :: fs) (styp_rcd l A) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l' B' IHB]; intros fs l A H2.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs l A H3) as [c1 Hc1].
    destruct (IHB2 fs l A H4) as [c2 Hc2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) l A H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l']) l A H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
Qed.

(* reflexivity of the algorithmic judgment *)
Lemma ASub_refl : forall (A:styp), exists c, ASub nil A A c.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2|l A IHA].
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_nat.
  - destruct IHA1 as [c1 H1]. destruct IHA2 as [c2 H2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - destruct IHA1 as [c1 H1]. destruct IHA2 as [c2 H2].
    destruct (ASub_arr_lift A2 nil A1 A1 A2 H1 H2) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. apply Hc.
  - destruct IHA as [c H]. destruct (ASub_rcd_lift A nil l A H) as [c' Hc'].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. apply Hc'.
Qed.

Theorem ASub2sub : forall fs A B c,
    ASub fs A B c -> sub A (applyfs fs B) c.

Theorem sub2ASub : forall A B c,
    sub A B c -> exists c', ASub nil A B c'.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import syntax_ott.
Require Import List.
Import ListNotations.

Lemma applyfs_app : forall (fs1 fs2:ls) (B:styp),
    applyfs (fs1 ++ fs2) B = applyfs fs1 (applyfs fs2 B).
Proof.
  intros fs1. induction fs1 as [|x xs IH]; intros fs2 B.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct x as [A|l]; simpl; [rewrite IH | rewrite IH]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma applyfs_snoc_ty : forall (fs:ls) (A B:styp),
    applyfs (fs ++ [st_ty A]) B = applyfs fs (styp_arrow A B).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite applyfs_app. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma applyfs_snoc_la : forall (fs:ls) (l:i) (B:styp),
    applyfs (fs ++ [st_la l]) B = applyfs fs (styp_rcd l B).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite applyfs_app. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma app_assoc' : forall (a b c:list st), (a ++ b) ++ c = a ++ (b ++ c).
Proof. intros. rewrite app_assoc. reflexivity. Qed.

(* and_left *)
Lemma ASub_and_l : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2 B:styp) (c:co),
    ASub fs A1 B c -> exists c', ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) B c'.
Proof.
  intros fs A1 A2 B c H. induction H.
  - (* A_nat *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_nat.
  - (* A_rcdNat *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - (* A_rcd *) eexists. apply A_rcd. apply IHH.
  - (* A_top *) eexists. apply A_top.
  - (* A_and *) eexists. apply A_and; assumption.
  - (* A_arr *) eexists. apply A_arr. apply IHH.
  - (* A_andN1 *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_andN1. assumption.
  - (* A_andN2 *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_andN2. assumption.
  - (* A_arrNat *) eexists. apply A_andN1. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ASub_and_r : forall (fs:ls) (A1 A2 B:styp) (c:co),
    ASub fs A2 B c -> exists c', ASub fs (styp_and A1 A2) B c'.
Proof.
  intros fs A1 A2 B c H. induction H.
  - (* A_nat *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_nat.
  - (* A_rcdNat *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - (* A_rcd *) eexists. apply A_rcd. apply IHH.
  - (* A_top *) eexists. apply A_top.
  - (* A_and *) eexists. apply A_and; assumption.
  - (* A_arr *) eexists. apply A_arr. apply IHH.
  - (* A_andN1 *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_andN1. assumption.
  - (* A_andN2 *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_andN2. assumption.
  - (* A_arrNat *) eexists. apply A_andN2. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
Qed.

(* lift arrow on top of a derivation *)
Lemma ASub_arr_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (B1 A1 A2:styp),
    ASub nil B1 A1 ->
    ASub fs A2 B ->
    exists c, ASub (st_ty B1 :: fs) (styp_arrow A1 A2) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l B' IHB]; intros fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H2.
  - (* top *) eexists. apply A_top.
  - (* nat *) eexists. apply A_arrNat; assumption.
  - (* and *) inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c1 Hc1].
    destruct (IHB2 fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H4) as [c2 Hc2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - (* arrow *) inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
  - (* rcd *) inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l]) B1 A1 A2 H1 H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
Qed.

Lemma ASub_rcd_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (l:i) (A:styp),
    ASub fs A B ->
    exists c, ASub (st_la l :: fs) (styp_rcd l A) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l' B' IHB]; intros fs l A H2.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_rcdNat. assumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs l A H3) as [c1 Hc1].
    destruct (IHB2 fs l A H4) as [c2 Hc2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) l A H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l']) l A H3) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc.
Qed.

(* reflexivity *)
Lemma ASub_refl : forall (A:styp), exists c, ASub nil A A c.
Proof.
  induction A as [| |A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2|A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2|l A IHA].
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_nat.
  - destruct IHA1 as [c1 H1]. destruct IHA2 as [c2 H2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - destruct IHA1 as [c1 H1]. destruct IHA2 as [c2 H2].
    destruct (ASub_arr_lift A2 nil A1 A1 A2 H1 H2) as [c Hc].
    eexists. apply A_arr. apply Hc.
  - destruct IHA as [c H]. destruct (ASub_rcd_lift A nil l A H) as [c' Hc'].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. apply Hc'.
Qed.

(* lifting a derivation under an arrow constructor *)
Lemma ASub_arr_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (B1 A1 A2:styp) (c1 c2:co),
    ASub nil B1 A1 c1 ->
    ASub fs A2 B c2 ->
    exists c, ASub (st_ty B1 :: fs) (styp_arrow A1 A2) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l B' IHB]; intros fs B1 A1 A2 H1 H2.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_arrNat; [exact H1 | exact H2].
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs B1 A1 A2 c1 c0 H1 H3) as [c3 Hc3].
    destruct (IHB2 fs B1 A1 A2 c1 c4 H1 H4) as [c5 Hc5].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) B1 A1 A2 c1 c0 H1 H3) as [c3 Hc3].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc3.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l]) B1 A1 A2 c1 c0 H1 H3) as [c3 Hc3].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc3.
Qed.

(* lifting a derivation under a record constructor *)
Lemma ASub_rcd_lift : forall (B:styp) (fs:ls) (l:i) (A:styp) (c2:co),
    ASub fs A B c2 ->
    exists c, ASub (st_la l :: fs) (styp_rcd l A) B c.
Proof.
  induction B as [| |B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|B1' B2' IHB1 IHB2|l' B' IHB]; intros fs l A c2 H2.
  - eexists. apply A_top.
  - eexists. apply A_rcdNat. exact H2.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB1 fs l A c0 H3) as [c1' Hc1].
    destruct (IHB2 fs l A c4 H4) as [c2' Hc2].
    eexists. apply A_and; eassumption.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB2 (fs ++ [st_ty B1']) l A c0 H3) as [c3 Hc3].
    eexists. apply A_arr. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc3.
  - inversion H2; subst.
    destruct (IHB (fs ++ [st_la l']) l A c0 H3) as [c3 Hc3].
    eexists. apply A_rcd. rewrite app_assoc. apply Hc3.
Qed.

(* reflexivity of the algorithmic judgment *)
Lemma ASub_refl : forall (A:styp), exists c, ASub nil A A c.
Proof.

## Proof structure

All added material lives in `Task.v` between `applyfs` and the two theorems; the supplied definitions and target statements are unchanged, and there is no `admit`/`Admitted`/`Abort`/`Axiom`/`Parameter`.

**Soundness (`ASub2sub`)** — induction on the `ASub` derivation, using:
- `applyfs_app` / `applyfs_snoc_ty` / `applyfs_snoc_la` to reassociate the stack (`applyfs (fs ++ [st_la l]) B = applyfs fs (rcd l B)`, etc.);
- `calTop_sound : sub top (applyfs fs top) (calTop fs)` and `calAnd_sound : sub (and (applyfs fs B1) (applyfs fs B2)) (applyfs fs (and B1 B2)) (calAnd fs)` (inductions on `fs`).

**Completeness (`sub2ASub`)** — induction on the `sub` derivation. The work is in constructing algorithmic derivations:
- `ASub_and_l` / `ASub_and_r`: wrap a source in an intersection (induction on the `ASub` derivation).
- `ASub_arr_lift` / `ASub_rcd_lift`: push a derivation under an arrow/record constructor (induction on the target type).
- `ASub_refl`: every type is algorithmically reflexive (uses the two lift lemmas).
- `ASub_comp` (composition/stack concatenation): `ASub fs1 A1 A` and `ASub fs2 A B` give `ASub (fs1++fs2) A1 B`. Proved by induction on the second derivation with a size-measure sub-induction on the source; the arrow case needs `ASub_ann_change`, which rewrites a `st_ty A'` stack annotation to `st_ty X` when `X <: A'` (proved by induction on the derivation, tracking the split `pre ++ [st_ty A'] ++ post`).

With these, each `sub` rule maps directly (`S_arr`/`S_rcd`/`S_distArr`/`S_distRcd` via the lift lemmas plus `ASub_and_l/r`, `S_andl/r` via `ASub_and_l/r` on `ASub_refl`, `S_trans` via `ASub_comp`).
